title: Mrs
staffNotes: ILR SET(O) — demo case from Resources checklist.
checklistExtract: Set (O) ILR checklist. Previous passports. Absence from UK.

slots.instructions:
Upload a clear scan or photo of the passport identity page (and any pages requested in your checklist).

Ensure all four edges are visible, on a plain background, with no glare or shadow. Every word and the photo must be readable.

slots.documentName: Letter from employer confirming reason for absence
slots.targetFileName: 2 Letter from employer confirming reason for absence
slots.instructions:
Upload a signed letter from your employer confirming the reason for your absence from the UK.

**ILR absence evidence:** The letter must state the **dates of absence**, the **purpose of travel**, and that the absence was **agreed** with your employer. These dates must match your travel ticket in the paired upload slot.

The letter should be on company letterhead where possible, signed, and dated.

slots.documentName: Travel ticket proving absence from the UK
slots.targetFileName: 2 Travel ticket proving absence from the UK
slots.instructions:
Upload your travel ticket or booking confirmation showing travel **outside the UK** for the absence period referred to in your employer letter.

**ILR absence evidence:** Dates and destinations must be clearly visible and must align with the dates in your employer’s absence letter.

A booking confirmation or e-ticket is fine if all travel dates are readable.

Upload a screenshot of your eVisa (or digital status) from your UKVI account.

The **visa start date** and **visa expiry date** must both be clearly visible. A screenshot is sufficient.

If either date is missing or unreadable, the upload does not prove your leave — please retake the screenshot.

Generate a new share code on GOV.UK and upload a screenshot or PDF showing the full code.

When asked what you need the code for, select **“To prove an immigration matter”** — this is the option to **prove immigration status** for something else. Do **not** select “right to rent” or “right to work”.

The code should have at least **one month** of validity remaining. If you cannot generate a valid code, contact your adviser before uploading.
donts: Selecting "right to rent" or "right to work" instead of immigration matter

slots.instructions:
Please complete and sign the **first page** of the attached document. Kindly ensure that all required fields are completed, including your **full name, address, postcode, date, and signature**. Once completed, upload the signed document here with your other documents.

Download the blank Home Office consent form using the button below if you have not already received it.

Upload a bank statement that shows the payment listed on your payslip.

**ILR financial evidence:** The statement should be dated **no earlier than one calendar month before your application date**. Account holder name, statement dates, and the payslip transaction must be readable.

If your adviser asked for a longer period of statements, follow their instructions instead.

Upload your most recent payslip.

**ILR financial evidence:** Home Office guidance expects the payslip to be dated **no earlier than one calendar month before your application date**, unless your adviser has given different guidance.

The **gross/net pay** and **pay date** must be clearly readable. Your bank statement upload should show the payment from this payslip.

Upload a letter from your employer confirming your employment and sponsorship details as required for your ILR application.

The letter should be on company letterhead, signed, and dated.

Upload your Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS) reference document, or the letter from your employer confirming that the CoS has been issued if the CoS is still pending.

If your CoS is pending, a short text file or employer letter explaining the status is acceptable — your adviser will confirm.

If you have been issued a BRP, upload a clear scan or photo showing the front of the card.

Use the same quality standards as a passport: four edges visible, plain background, no glare, all text readable.
Your adviser will prepare the covering letter for this application. You do not need to upload a file for this item.
